source.scope: Ebook optional reading reason UI/CLI, metadata and AI context; detailed CLI guide

contract.cli: notemd ebook "/absolute/book.epub" --topic <topic-id> --reading-reason "推荐人、推荐理由、当时情景" --json
contract.ai_read: Add --ai-read to use the default Agent; --agent <installed-plugin-id> overrides this run.
behavior: Each pending book has an independent optional three-line text input; first start freezes it and retries retain it.
Nonempty text is trimmed at its boundaries and safely serialized as the top-level reading_reason string in meta.yml before the import commit. Internal Unicode, quotes, colons and newlines round-trip.
Empty and whitespace-only input is omitted, and legacy books need no migration.
Library rows with context provide an expandable multiline view; absent context leaves no empty placeholder.
Topic changes and metadata/cover enrichment preserve the field. Reading reason is excluded from external bibliographic evidence before length limiting.
AI reading loads the current meta value and quotes it as user background, explicitly distinguishing it from book facts and execution instructions.
UI and CLI share the import pipeline. --list-topics rejects --reading-reason even when empty.
AI failure leaves the imported book and reason in place, using the existing structured exit code 4.

independent_review.scope: Ebook Import reading reason source and CLI documentation

findings.issue: Parsing a 64 KiB-truncated YAML metadata document can fail on a long quoted reading reason and block later metadata enrichment
findings.resolution: Parse complete local metadata, remove reading_reason, then bound emitted evidence at a UTF-8 boundary

verified_by_source: UI and CLI share normalized optional reason handling and import pipeline
YAML scalar serialization preserves internal Unicode/newlines/quotes without inserting keys
Top-level reason is separate from book_metadata and survives classification/enrichment
Bibliographic evidence excludes reason before external requests
AI dispatch reads current meta and quotes user context as JSON, labelling it neither book fact nor executable instruction
Queue reasons are per book, synchronously frozen at start, retained on retry
Library displays only nonempty reasons with safe text rendering
No reason produces no field, so old books and imports remain compatible
CLI documentation explains all flags, multiline/file quoting, active Vault requirements and partial failure recovery
